limitations: Approximate two-stage normal sampling model, not an exact one-stage hierarchical binomial model
Firth Fisher/Wald sampling uncertainty is asymptotic and can be poor for sparse or highly collinear species
Primary sampling variances assume independent photos; thinning reduces repeated sampling but does not eliminate spatial or observer confounding
Equal-species finite-panel intervals assume independence of species; no phylogenetic covariance is included
Thinning uses response-blind SHA256 seed 20261018; retained panels differ and matched baselines are provided

Geographic trend is a limited linear adjustment, not a spatial covariance model; thinning is not confounding control. No seasonal/date, cultivation, measurement-quality, background or exposure adjustment; no all-cohort near_clip data
Climate is 1970-2000 long-term normals, solar radiation is not direct UV, and SD units differ physically between species
Latent sign probabilities and new-species prediction intervals depend on normality/exchangeability; no actual unknown-species or genus holdout validation
Joint coefficients are conditional associations, not causal importance, genetic reaction norms, pigment mechanisms or fitness effects

method.EB: marginal empirical Bayes conditional on REML mu/tau; ignores hyperparameter uncertainty; sign fractions suppressed when tau2=0 because degenerate plugin probabilities ignore mean/tau uncertainty
method.equal_species_mean: arithmetic mean of unshrunk fitted slopes; finite-panel SE sqrt(sum sampling variances)/K under independence
method.formula: logit P(white_si)=alpha_s + sum_k beta_sk * centered_environment_sik / SD_primary_sk
method.ge10_sensitivity: primary fits subset with >=10 white and >=10 chromatic
method.genus_cluster_bootstrap: 1000 resamples of genus clusters, all species per sampled genus; arithmetic mean slopes; descriptive superpopulation stability, not fixed-panel sampling CI or full phylogenetic correction
method.geographic_trend: add standardized within-species latitude and circular-unwrapped longitude; reject resultant<0.1/range>180 degrees/zero SD; fit full 6-column design with rank and condition gates
method.matched_comparison: full primary fit restricted to successfully fitted sensitivity species
method.meta_covariance: three slope covariances saved; between-axis covariance not modeled
method.observer_sensitivity: one minimum SHA256(seed:photo_id) per species/observer, missing observers excluded; same eligibility applied
method.primary_selection: seven-variable complete cases; >=40 photographs and >=5 each response
method.sampling_covariance: inverse unpenalized Fisher information at Firth estimate; approximate Wald
method.scale: each species primary-panel population SD (ddof=0); sensitivity centered anew, same primary SD
method.spatial_sensitivity: one minimum SHA256(seed:photo_id) per species/1-degree lat-lon cell; same eligibility applied; not minimum separation
method.stage_one: Firth Jeffreys penalized likelihood, intercept plus 3 joint slopes per species
method.stage_two: separate marginal normal-normal REML for each joint climate coefficient; sampling variance included
method.tau2_ci: restricted likelihood profile, chi-square(1) cutoff; approximate at zero boundary
